messages.text: BL-2074 🎵 in progress — Stamp-off for hotfix 9b89a6e5db: BL-2064's own read-budget invariant reset the count on a bare compaction, handing the iq3 coder a fresh 12 reads right after it lost context - exactly the 'reading frenzy' the human watched happen; the guard now resets only on an edit/write or a state-changing command, warns from the 12th qualifying read, and defers the 24th-read restart to BL-2064's own build
